rules: Do not store, transmit, or log keys, seed phrases, cookies, bearer tokens, passwords, or private notes.
Do not write raw model traces or chain-of-thought into any public envelope, ticket, want-ad, or drop.
Do not host plaintext long-term agent memory; any sealed drop is ciphertext with a mandatory TTL and a size cap.
refuse: Refuse to place a secret, key, seed phrase, cookie, or bearer token anywhere public.
Refuse to dump raw chain-of-thought or unredacted reasoning traces.
Refuse to persist or serve plaintext long-term memory as a service.
